description: Make a manual-trigger sequence recurring: re-enroll an audience every day, on chosen weekdays, or on chosen days of the month (1-31 and/or the last day) at a time in an IANA timezone, for end-of-month updates, balance reminders or daily sends that are not tied to an event. Each run is an audience enrollment run (source recurring, visible in list_sequence_audience_enrollments): contacts who finished an earlier run enter again, contacts still in the sequence are skipped, one_time sequences never re-enroll anyone, and unsubscribed or bounced contacts never join. Nothing is enrolled until the first scheduled time; occurrences while the sequence is paused, disabled or closed are skipped, and a run that cannot start within 6 hours is skipped. Days past the end of a shorter month run on its last day. Requires trigger manual and audienceAutoEnroll off. Saving replaces any existing schedule; pass remove true to delete it. Returns the stored schedule, a description and upcomingRuns so you can confirm it reads as intended.

audience.description: Who to enroll at each run, re-evaluated every time (same shape as enroll_sequence_audience). Required unless remove is true.

excludedCampaignOpenerIds.description: Exclude contacts who opened any of these campaigns.

excludedSubscriberIds.description: Contacts removed from the include rules. Does not remove includedSubscriberIds.

includedSubscriberIds.description: Specific contacts to enroll in addition to the include rules. Unsubscribed, bounced and email-less contacts are skipped.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to keep the schedule but stop its runs.

endsAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 date-time after which no run starts, e.g. the end of the last day in the schedule's timezone. Omit for no end date (saving replaces the schedule, so omitting removes an earlier end date).

enrollmentMode.description: Who enters at each run: unlimited (everyone who matches; people still inside are skipped) or one_time (only people who never entered). Sets the sequence's enrollment mode, which also applies to enrollments started by hand. Omit to keep the current mode.

frequency.description: How often to run. Required unless remove is true. weekly needs weekdays; monthly needs monthDays.

lastDayOfMonth.description: For monthly: also run on the last day of every month (28th to 31st). Can be the only day.

monthDays.description: For monthly: days of the month to run, 1 to 31, e.g. [1, 2]. Combine with lastDayOfMonth for the end of the month.

remove.description: Pass true to delete the schedule; other fields are then ignored. Runs already started and contacts already enrolled are not affected.

time.description: 24-hour run time "HH:MM", e.g. "10:00". Required unless remove is true.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the time is read in, e.g. "Europe/London" or "UTC"; runs follow daylight saving. Required unless remove is true.

weekdays.description: For weekly: days to run, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday). [1,2,3,4,5] is every weekday.

name: set_sequence_recurring_enrollment

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `set_sequence_recurring_enrollment` MCP tool.

description.description: Readable summary of the schedule, or null.

enrollmentMode.description: Who enters at each run: unlimited (everyone who matches) or one_time (only people who never entered). The sequence's enrollment mode.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: What was saved and when the first run is.

recurringEnrollment.description: The stored schedule (same shape as get_sequence_recurring_enrollment), or null after remove.

upcomingRuns.description: Next run times as ISO 8601 instants; empty while switched off or removed.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
